question: Among historically known route species that are silent at a focal dry-survey SiteID, does a strong chorus recorded at that same SiteID four or more years earlier predict strong reactivation in the paired wetter survey?
population: Physically stable matched NAAMP pairs with at least one eligible run in the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum before the earlier focal-pair year.
candidate_species: Defined without wet-survey outcomes: all species recorded anywhere on the same route-season stratum strictly before the earlier focal-pair year.
unit: pair x candidate species x physical SiteID, restricted to dry CallingIndex=0 at the focal stop.

memory_age.recent: Most recent prior CallingIndex 2-3 at the same SiteID occurred 1-3 years before the earlier focal-pair year.
memory_age.old: Most recent prior CallingIndex 2-3 at the same SiteID occurred >=4 years before the earlier focal-pair year.
memory_age.none: No prior CallingIndex 2-3 at that SiteID for the candidate species.

outcomes.primary: wet_strong = 1 if wet CallingIndex is 2 or 3.

primary_design: Use only pair x species groups containing at least one old-memory SiteID and one no-memory SiteID. Demean outcome, old-memory and recent-memory indicators exactly within pair x species; OLS without intercept; route-clustered covariance. The old-memory coefficient is the primary estimand.
minimum_gate: Before reading outcomes, require >=500 informative pair x species groups, >=250 routes and >=20 species based only on history/memory predictors.
primary_prediction: old-memory coefficient >0 with complete 95% CI >0 for wet_strong.
sensitivities: Among SiteIDs with prior strong memory, estimate continuous log1p(years-since-last-strong) slope after pair x species demeaning; descriptive only.
interpretation: Support indicates a durable species-specific local acoustic template: sites used for strong chorus >=4 years earlier are preferentially reactivated when the same species is silent in the paired dry survey.
It does not prove continuous occupancy, survival of the same individuals, philopatry, biological memory, or unchanged habitat.
No causal rainfall or reproductive-success claim is authorized.
same_observer_sensitivity_gate: >=300 informative pair x species groups, >=200 routes and >=20 species; otherwise report not estimable without relaxing the gate.
